verdict.rationale: Shopify's hardware and Tap to Pay pages say it will 'turn your smartphone into a checkout' with Tap to Pay. It accepts contactless credit/debit cards, smartwatches, Apple Pay and Google Pay over WiFi or cellular, which implies no separate reader is needed, and the POS app runs on iOS and Android phones. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Tap to Pay, and documentation of device, region and eligibility requirements or limits.
